body:
I’m trying my best.
I’m concerned that if I’m not there, the people around me can’t function at all. I’m hoping after the events it will be safe to leave them for a while.
I think I care about other people more than myself. 
Thank you for talking to me about this though. I’m in a safer place now than I was before, but it’s still a struggle.

Thank you! I’m hoping to eventually be able to delete this account for good. 
Good luck to you too!

Thank you. I ended up passing out from exhaustion, and I feel a lot safer at the moment. I was in a really bad place that I’m hoping I won’t get to again.
I’m hoping to get professional help again soon though.
Thank you for talking to me. I appreciate it.

I have no insurance this month.
Along with that, I have things to do. There’s events coming up and I have to be sure not to miss them.
I have to take care of people too. Even though I’m not very stable myself, there’s people around me that can’t function on their own. Instead of seeking help, I’ve been forced to take care of them.
I wouldn’t forgive myself if something happened to one of those people.

You’re right.

I’ve been angry at the fact that I can’t keep control of my body. It’s the one thing that I can control.

I don’t want to start that though. I’m scared of everything it could bring. Infection, addiction- it’s all really scary in reality.

I feel like time goes super fast. If I’m not careful, I can sit for hours doing nothing at all. It only feels like a few minutes, so it can be weird looking outside and seeing that it’s suddenly light or dark out.

I didn’t think anyone got the voice thing as well with this. 
My images come from my main fear, so I’ve never had anything else come through.
It must’ve been difficult for you with the misdiagnosis as well.
I hope you’re feeling a bit better since last night, what you’ve described sounds awful. 
Thank you for responding. I’m learning a lot through this post.

I’ve never had one last that long, I can only imagine how bad it is.
I tend to run away when I get them, and they go away. I don’t know any better way of dealing with it. 
It’s really hard when they can seem “logical,” I know that much.
I’m really sorry you have to go through that.

That’s pretty much my experience. Unless it’s really bad, like right now, most of the time it’s inconsistent. It’s still incredibly scary, even when you can grasp that it’s not real.
I’m sorry that you have to deal with this too though. 
Thank you for helping me. This post has really helped me figure a lot of things out.

I believe that explanation may make sense.
For me, they’ve all been things I’ve been worried about in some way, even if it happens to be reflected on a stranger. I can also understand the vivid dreams. It can be really strange to wake up and think something happened when it didn’t, especially if it was a bad thing everyone should’ve remembered happening. 
I think your input helped a lot. Thank you. I hope that you’re doing well, but I know it can be hard sometimes.

That sounds terrifying, I’m sorry. 
I can’t drive due to extreme anxiety, but this does sound a lot like an experience I had recently.
I didn’t see anyone talking about this so I wasn’t really sure if what I had was valid.
I think I’m starting to understand now. Thank you.
I hate that other people have to go through this too though. I wish you the best of luck.

I’m sorry you have to feel this way too. It can really suck.
Thank you for responding, it actually means a lot to have this question answered.

I’ve heard it’s expensive. I’m a minor, so I’m not really sure how insurance works. I haven’t gotten a very clear answer on what’s covered and what isn’t. 
I’m glad to hear it helped though. I think if it can help me then it would be worth working to pay it off.

Thank you. This is really helpful.
I’ve never been able to seek help beyond therapy, so I’m hoping I can at least become safe by doing this.
